profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Vertafore
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer specializing in enterprise systems, .NET platforms, SQL Server, systems integration, and modernization of complex business applications.
 
I have extensive experience designing, developing, supporting, and modernizing enterprise software across government, logistics, manufacturing, and other large business environments. My primary background is in C#, .NET, SQL Server, APIs, integration systems, production support, and application architecture, with additional experience across Angular, PowerShell, Azure, Oracle, Java, messaging, batch processing, and reporting platforms.
 
Much of my career has involved stepping into mature systems, understanding how they actually behave in production, and making them more reliable, maintainable, and easier to support. I particularly enjoy diagnosing difficult production problems, tracing data across system boundaries, untangling integration and batch-processing failures, and improving legacy applications without disrupting the business that depends on them.
 
I have worked both as a senior developer and as a subject matter expert supporting large enterprise platforms, often bridging development, infrastructure, QA, and business teams. My experience includes API and integration development, cloud migration, production reliability, database and data-flow troubleshooting, mentoring developers and QA staff, and modernization of long-lived enterprise applications.
 
I am currently a Senior Software Developer on the NetRate Systems team at Vertafore, supporting enterprise software for the insurance industry.

Currently based in Lansing, Michigan. Canadian citizen and U.S. Permanent Resident, authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Senior Software Developer on Vertafore's NetRate Systems team, supporting enterprise software for the insurance industry.

Working with a mature Object Pascal / Delphi 2007 Windows application and its modern C#/.NET services. The role includes supporting the existing platform and contributing to the phased modernization of insurance rating functionality using ASP.NET Core, .NET, SQL Server, and automated unit and integration testing.

positions.title: Independent Software Engineer / Application Support Consultant
positions.description:
Independent software engineering and application support consulting for private clients.
 
Developed custom invoicing, expense-tracking, and financial workflow solutions using C#, Excel VBA, and SQL.
 
Performed application testing, defect validation, documentation, and user-experience support for web and locally hosted applications.
 
Technologies: .NET Framework 4.8, C#, Excel VBA, SQL, Git
positions.insights: Skills: Job Scheduling · Oracle SQL Developer · Data Pipelines · Data Reconciliation · SAP BusinessObjects · PL/SQL · Crystal Reports · Application Support · Legacy Modernization · Stakeholder Engagement · Systems Integration · Batch Processing · Data Integration · Legacy Systems · System Architecture

positions.title: Programmer 3 (Contract)
positions.description:
Programmer 3 contractor supporting State of Michigan enterprise applications through Agile Tech Labs.
 
Developed and supported enterprise applications in a C#/.NET, Angular/Typescript, and SQL Server environment.

Analyzed and troubleshot a mature multi-tier application while contributing to maintenance and modernization efforts.

Collaborated with developers, technical leads, and embedded business stakeholders in an Agile development process.

Participated in the application's transition to AWS, along with performance-testing and modernization discussions.

positions.title: MES Programmer
positions.description:
Built integration interfaces between manufacturing systems and third‑party platforms. 

Modernized legacy applications to current .NET versions while maintaining operational continuity. 

Developed a warehouse inventory management system used by production personnel. 

Designed test‑mode frameworks allowing validation of production‑impacting code before deployment.

positions.title: Application Support Specialist III
positions.description:
Diagnosed and resolved production incidents involving application integrations, data flows, and third-party enterprise systems. 

Developed APIs and data exchange services connecting previously unintegrated systems across operational and financial platforms. 

Investigated data discrepancies and reconciliation issues using SQL analysis and cross-system tracing. 

Implemented PowerShell and T-SQL automation tools to accelerate troubleshooting and operational support. 

Served as SME for multiple enterprise applications during post-acquisition system consolidation between USA Truck and DB Schenker environments. 

Supported production batch processes and scheduled integrations by investigating failures, analyzing logs, and coordinating fixes across development and infrastructure teams.

positions.title: Senior Application Delivery & Support Analyst
positions.description:
Led migration of the LMS hosting environment from a dedicated data center to Microsoft Azure, including data, logging, deployment, and source-control modernization. 
 
 Migrated appropriate static data from SQL Server to Azure Cosmos DB or Azure-hosted SQL Server, and moved application logging to Azure Application Insights. 
 
 Modernized deployment and source-control processes from self-hosted Octopus Deploy and TFS to cloud-hosted Octopus, Azure DevOps, and Git. 
 
 Supported customer and internal migration initiatives, including geolocation-platform changes and transition of citizen-developed applications into managed IT solutions. 
 
 Mentored developers and QA staff through coding/testing reviews, regression validation, and Agile release processes.

positions.title: Site Reliability Analyst / Subject Matter Expert (SME), LMS
positions.description:
Served as Subject Matter Expert for Ryder’s business-critical Logistics Management System, with responsibility for operational stability, architecture, and technical planning. 
 
 Designed and implemented disaster-recovery environments, failover procedures, and recovery testing. 
 
 Investigated production incidents across application, database, and service layers and coordinated resolution across development and infrastructure teams. 
 
 Guided projects involving migration of application hosting and development infrastructure toward cloud services. 
 
 Participated in regular 24/7 on-call rotations, responding to production incidents and supporting early-morning and late-night deployments.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Designed and developed enterprise integrations for an automotive-focused logistics management system built primarily with C#, ASP.NET, JavaScript, and SQL Server. 
 
 Created a WCF service wrapping ALK PC Miler’s COM interface to provide route-distance calculations for logistics applications. 
 
 Designed a T-SQL framework for scheduled conversion of database data to XML, supporting exchange between Manhattan SCALE and internal logistics systems. 
 
 Developed and maintained secure Web APIs and other integration services connecting internal and third-party systems. 
 
 Maintained Team Foundation Server, Visual Studio, source-control processes, and development infrastructure while contributing to application architecture and development practices. 
 
 Mentored QA staff and supported coding, testing, and release processes.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Performed in-house software development for a technology consulting organization. 
 
 Designed and developed integration systems enabling third-party software packages to exchange data. 
 
 Implemented low-level socket communications in C across Unix and Windows platforms. 
 
 Maintained existing applications and provided technical support to fellow developers.

positions.title: Systems Engineer – EDS / State Medicaid Systems
positions.description:
Maintained and enhanced proprietary systems supporting multiple state Medicaid programs. 
 
 Worked across varied technical assignments in a team environment with both local and distributed team members. 
 
 Mentored junior programmers and provided technical assistance with system configuration and support issues.
